attr.title: Heroes Lore Wind of Soltia
attr.desc: Native C++ / SDL2 port of the J2ME action RPG, rebuilt from the original game data: three heroes, guardians, field combat, Russian language option and a modern menu style.
attr.inst: Copy the game's J2ME .jar into ports/heroeslore. Optional: a General MIDI SoundFont (.sf2) there for better music.
